title: LiteLLM Management Summary
description: Executive usage, cost, reliability, governance, and directional ROI indicators.

options.content:
### Management summary
Usage and cost come from LiteLLM's system-of-record PostgreSQL data. **Indicative ROI is directional, not an accounting measure.** It adds the configured value per successful request and per distinct successful session, applies the realization factor and loaded hourly cost, then subtracts model spend. Assumptions come from `.env` and are shown below. Set either request or session minutes to zero when both would represent the same saved work.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Requests" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0)::float AS "Spend" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0)::float AS "Success rate" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF("user", ''))::float AS "Active users" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")

panels.title: Estimated hours saved
panels.description: Request and distinct-session contributions from the environment-managed assumptions.

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS requests, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(session_id, '')) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS sessions FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")) SELECT ((totals.requests * config.minutes_saved_per_request + totals.sessions * config.minutes_saved_per_session) / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor)::float AS "Hours saved" FROM totals CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE config.singleton = 1

panels.title: Estimated gross value
panels.description: Estimated hours saved multiplied by the environment-managed loaded hourly cost.

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS requests, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(session_id, '')) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS sessions FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")) SELECT ((totals.requests * config.minutes_saved_per_request + totals.sessions * config.minutes_saved_per_session) / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor * config.loaded_hourly_cost)::float AS "Gross value" FROM totals CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE config.singleton = 1

panels.title: Estimated net value
panels.description: Estimated gross labor value less direct model spend.

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS requests, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(session_id, '')) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0)::numeric AS spend FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")) SELECT ((totals.requests * config.minutes_saved_per_request + totals.sessions * config.minutes_saved_per_session) / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor * config.loaded_hourly_cost - totals.spend)::float AS "Net value" FROM totals CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE config.singleton = 1

panels.title: Indicative ROI
panels.description: (Estimated gross value - model spend) / model spend. Directional estimate only.

targets.rawSql: WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS requests, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(session_id, '')) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(spend), 0)::numeric AS spend FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")) SELECT CASE WHEN totals.spend > 0 THEN 100.0 * ((totals.requests * config.minutes_saved_per_request + totals.sessions * config.minutes_saved_per_session) / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor * config.loaded_hourly_cost - totals.spend) / totals.spend ELSE 0 END::float AS "ROI" FROM totals CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE config.singleton = 1
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE max_budget IS NOT NULL AND max_budget > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0)::float AS "Budget coverage" FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken"

SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE max_budget IS NOT NULL AND max_budget > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0)::float AS "Budget coverage" FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" WHERE COALESCE(blocked, false) = false
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Over budget" FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" WHERE max_budget IS NOT NULL AND max_budget > 0 AND COALESCE(spend, 0) > max_budget
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Unavailable keys" FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" WHERE COALESCE(blocked, false) = true OR (expires IS NOT NULL AND expires <= NOW())
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(spend) FILTER (WHERE team_id IS NULL OR team_id = '') / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0), 0)::float AS "Unassigned spend" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")

SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(cache_hit::text, 'false')) IN ('true', '1')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0)::float AS "Cache hits" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Provider errors" FROM "LiteLLM_ErrorLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
SELECT COUNT(*)::float AS "Changes" FROM "LiteLLM_AuditLog" WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1d'), COALESCE(status, 'unknown') AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily spend vs estimated gross value
panels.description: The value series combines the environment-managed request and session assumptions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '1d'), 'Model spend' AS metric, SUM(spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(logs."startTime", '1d'), 'Estimated gross value' AS metric, ((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(logs.status, 'success') = 'success') * config.minutes_saved_per_request + COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(logs.session_id, '')) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(logs.status, 'success') = 'success') * config.minutes_saved_per_session) / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor * config.loaded_hourly_cost)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" logs CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE $__timeFilter(logs."startTime") AND config.singleton = 1 GROUP BY 1, config.minutes_saved_per_request, config.minutes_saved_per_session, config.value_realization_factor, config.loaded_hourly_cost ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(logs."startTime", '1d'), COALESCE(teams.team_alias, logs.team_id, 'unassigned') AS metric, SUM(logs.spend)::float AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" logs LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_TeamTable" teams ON teams.team_id = logs.team_id WHERE $__timeFilter(logs."startTime") GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(model_group, model, 'unknown') AS "Model", COUNT(*)::float AS "Requests", SUM(spend)::float AS "Spend" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Spend" DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT 'Team' AS "Type", COALESCE(team_alias, team_id, 'unnamed') AS "Name", COALESCE(spend, 0)::float AS "Spend", max_budget::float AS "Budget", CASE WHEN max_budget > 0 THEN (100.0 * COALESCE(spend, 0) / max_budget)::float END AS "Utilization %", COALESCE(blocked, false) AS "Blocked" FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" UNION ALL SELECT 'Key' AS "Type", COALESCE(key_alias, key_name, 'unnamed') AS "Name", COALESCE(spend, 0)::float AS "Spend", max_budget::float AS "Budget", CASE WHEN max_budget > 0 THEN (100.0 * COALESCE(spend, 0) / max_budget)::float END AS "Utilization %", COALESCE(blocked, false) AS "Blocked" FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" ORDER BY "Utilization %" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(model_group, model, 'unknown') AS "Model", COUNT(*)::float AS "Requests", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::float AS "Successful", COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0)::float AS "Success %", SUM(spend)::float AS "Spend" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY "Requests" DESC LIMIT 100

WITH totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS requests, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(session_id, '')) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(status, 'success') = 'success')::numeric AS sessions FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")) SELECT 'Successful requests' AS "Basis", totals.requests::float AS "Count", config.minutes_saved_per_request::float AS "Minutes each", (totals.requests * config.minutes_saved_per_request / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor)::float AS "Realized hours" FROM totals CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE config.singleton = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Distinct successful sessions', totals.sessions::float, config.minutes_saved_per_session::float, (totals.sessions * config.minutes_saved_per_session / 60.0 * config.value_realization_factor)::float FROM totals CROSS JOIN "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" config WHERE config.singleton = 1

SELECT minutes_saved_per_request::float AS "Minutes / request", minutes_saved_per_session::float AS "Minutes / session", value_realization_factor::float AS "Realization factor", loaded_hourly_cost::float AS "Loaded hourly cost", currency AS "Currency", updated_at AS "Applied at" FROM "LiteLLM_ManagementROIConfig" WHERE singleton = 1
